missing_claims.claim: The exact E7335 sample-index primer member used in the 2019 iMARGI experiments is unreported in all linked originals
missing_claims.evidence: Two independent reads of the iMARGI detailed author protocol and the current original NEB E7335 manual establish a six-base indexed primer family with twelve Set 1 members, but the experiment does not identify its selected member. The current v8.0 manual records index-table changes in 2018 and 2022. A contemporaneous 2018–2019 NEB manual was not located, so exact historical member bases and the claimed absence across all linked originals cannot be accepted.

conclusion: Defining, detailed author, MARGI predecessor and current E7335 vendor originals have two independent reads. The E7335 vendor original resolves the available twelve-member index family and universal PCR primer, while the author protocol retains only a six-base sample-index slot. The historical 2018–2019 NEB manual is unavailable; v8 revision history notes later index-table edits, and no selected index member or lot is stated. The source checklist and linked-information disposition remain blocked, and no missing-information claim is accepted.
